spec.goal: Fix real mentor-answer formatting corruption: fenced code blocks must remain literal while headings, emphasis and tables outside fences retain their current plain-text rendering. Preserve the 4200-character limit, truncation/incomplete notices and empty-input behavior.
acceptance: Fences start with 3 or more consecutive backticks or tildes, preceded by at most 3 spaces; opening fences may have an info string.
Only the same character repeated at least the opening length, with at most 3 leading spaces and only trailing whitespace, closes a fence.
Keep fence lines and interior text exactly after CRLF normalization, including Markdown symbols, blank lines and trailing spaces. Unclosed fences protect all remaining lines.
Keep existing prose formatting, blank-line collapsing outside code, empty-input behavior, output length limit and notice text. No other files, dependencies, tests, gates or commands may change.
spec.budgetRevision: First frozen run retained separately: 3 calls, 2 timeouts and one nonexistent-source hunk. Native CPU prefill 35s and generation 6-8 tokens/s require an explicit bounded 240s call budget. No automatic timeout retry.
spec.origin: Exact existing production Git blob; defect not injected. Developer supplies tests and infrastructure only. Model must supply the repair. No training.
